metadata.experiment: Iteration-2 ablation: does item-level latent appeal (phi) let content/hybrid heuristics overtake popularity in cold start?
metadata.description: REUSES the iteration-1 16-heuristic sweep pipeline verbatim (heuristics.py, eval_metrics.py, output.py, catalog_pool.py, synthetic.Catalog) on catalogs generated by generator_phi.py with an informativeness parameter phi in {0,0.25,0.5,1.0}: phi=0 reproduces the published null (within-category choice purely popularity-driven); phi>0 gives users genuine per-item preferences inside a category (P(v) ~ w_v(t)*exp(beta*theta_u[cat])*exp(phi*s), s mean-zero centered within category).  The popularity marginal is held MATCHED across phi (same items + latent factors; marginals gate KS<=0.05 / maxabs<=0.02 / |dHHI|<=0.02 / |dNormEntropy|<=0.03 per cell, see out/marginals_match_gate.csv).  Per (catalog, user, k, heuristic) the rank r of the true next purchase and the top-50 ranking are recorded: the complete signal for NDCG@k/Recall@k and bootstrap CIs.

heuristic_inventory.name: pop_global
heuristic_inventory.prior_art: Ji et al., A Re-visit of the Popularity Baseline, SIGIR 2020
heuristic_inventory.desc: score = screen purchase count of the item (L1O-pop).

heuristic_inventory.name: recency_pop_0.1
heuristic_inventory.desc: score = sum over screen events exp(-lambda*(T_now - t)); half-life = 0.1 x screen span.

heuristic_inventory.name: recency_pop_0.5
heuristic_inventory.desc: score = sum over screen events exp(-lambda*(T_now - t)); half-life = 0.5 x screen span.

heuristic_inventory.name: recency_pop_1.0
heuristic_inventory.desc: score = sum over screen events exp(-lambda*(T_now - t)); half-life = 1.0 x screen span (all-time).

heuristic_inventory.name: pop_category
heuristic_inventory.prior_art: banded popularity (P3-style), cf. B2P, Chaimalas et al., RecSys 2023
heuristic_inventory.desc: score = P(cat|user)^gamma * count(item); P(cat|user) from context, global shares at k=0.

heuristic_inventory.name: pop_price
heuristic_inventory.desc: score = P(price_band|user)^gamma * count(item); global shares at k=0.

heuristic_inventory.name: content_knn_1
heuristic_inventory.prior_art: content-based cold-start textbook remedy (Basu et al. 1998; Lops et al. 2011)
heuristic_inventory.desc: profile = mean of context item vectors; score = cosine(profile, item); 1-NN item expansion.

heuristic_inventory.name: content_knn_3
heuristic_inventory.desc: as content_knn_1 but each context item expanded by its 3 nearest content neighbours.

heuristic_inventory.name: content_knn_5
heuristic_inventory.desc: as content_knn_1 but each context item expanded by its 5 nearest content neighbours.

heuristic_inventory.name: last_item_nbhd
heuristic_inventory.desc: score = cosine to the LAST purchased item's feature vector only.

heuristic_inventory.name: co_purchase
heuristic_inventory.desc: score = max over context h of lift(item,h)=P(item|h)/P(item); L1O co-occurrence.

heuristic_inventory.name: lambda_hybrid_0.25
heuristic_inventory.prior_art: B2P P3: lambda*pop+(1-lambda)*content, Chaimalas et al., RecSys 2023
heuristic_inventory.desc: score = lam*norm_content + (1-lam)*norm_pop; k=0 degenerates to popularity.

heuristic_inventory.name: lambda_hybrid_0.5
heuristic_inventory.prior_art: B2P P3, Chaimalas et al., RecSys 2023

heuristic_inventory.name: lambda_hybrid_0.75
heuristic_inventory.prior_art: B2P P3, Chaimalas et al., RecSys 2023

heuristic_inventory.name: active_elic2
heuristic_inventory.prior_art: Bayesian active/adaptive elicitation: Golovin & Krause, ICML 2010 (adaptive submodularity); no canonical cold-start paper = gap
heuristic_inventory.desc: asks 2 forced-choice questions selected to maximize expected entropy reduction of the category posterior; k=0 only.

metrics: (recomputable from metadata_rank_{h} via NDCG_cut = 1/log2(r+1) if r<=cut else 0; Recall_cut = 1 if r<=cut else 0)

split_protocol.rule: temporal 80/20 at user level: screen = positions 1..floor(0.8*L), confirm = rest; ground truth for cell (u,k) = purchase at position k+1 (valid iff k+1 <= L); context = positions 1..k
split_protocol.fit: ALL fitted parameters use ONLY screen-half events; per cell the user's own events at positions 1..k+1 are excluded (L1O-pop): no leakage; confirm events never enter fitted parameters (C8 re-verified).
split_protocol.fold_rule: catalog-level fold from generator (sha256(catalog_id)); per-example metadata_fold = user's ground-truth half.
split_protocol.rng: np.random.default_rng(seed) per catalog; latent structure drawn from np.random.default_rng(seed*104729+3011) (latent_sample_seed).

phi_model.formula: s_{u,v} = z_v . p_{u,c} - mean_{v' in c}(z_{v'} . p_{u,c}); P_{u,v}(t) = w_v(t) * exp(beta*theta_u[cat_v]) * exp(phi * s_{u,v}), normalized over items; at phi=0 this is exactly the iteration-1 null.
phi_model.tag_encoding: tag d present on item v iff z_v[d] > 0 (+ 2 distractor tags)
phi_model.marginal_control: same items vector + same latent factors shared across phi levels per (config, seed); mean-zero within-category centering; marginals-match gate per cell

grid.n_users_per_catalog: 600 (|V|=20) / 1000 (|V|=100) / 1500 (|V|=500), then the ported adapter's bounded 1000-user subsample applies (documented in provenance)

phi_model.null_replication: the 18 iteration-1 pool synthetic families are REGENERATED at their ORIGINAL params via the byte-identical legacy generator path and compared to the published iteration-1 aggregates (NDCG@5 within 1e-6, headroom within 1e-3); the 4 real pool catalogs are re-evaluated from the identical pool files; see out/null_replication_bytecheck.csv + out/null_replication_comparison.csv (analyze_ablation.py).

metadata.tuning_disclosure: Every heuristic parameter is FIXED & DISCLOSED a priori (same as iteration-1: lambda in {0.25,0.5,0.75}, recency windows in {0.1,0.5,1.0} quantiles of screen span, content-kNN neighborhoods in {1,3,5}, popularity exponent beta=0.5, band weight gamma=1.0) or chosen ONLY on screen-half users (best popularity family for the headroom diagnostic).  The confirm half is NEVER used to select anything.
metadata.filtering: for k>=1 the user's own context items are excluded from every ranking
metadata.not_applicable_cells: content_knn_{1,3,5}, last_item_nbhd, pop_scaled_content, co_purchase are undefined at k=0; active_elic2 only at k=0; those cells have metadata_rank_{h}='' and no predict_{h}.
metadata.degenerate_cells: at k=0 the lambda_hybrid_* scores reduce to (1-lam)*normalized_popularity.
metadata.key_sanitization: '.' in heuristic names is replaced by '_' in metadata_rank_*/predict_* keys.
